question: The ______ festival of Sikkim is also known as Bhoomi Puja or Chandi Puja.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Sakewa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Sakewa festival is **also known as the Bhoomi puja or Chandi puja (worship of mother earth).** **
 
• **It is a religious festival celebrated by the Kirat Khambu Rai community of Sikkim.**
